messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please change the scene to the setting shown in the reference image, placing the person in that environment. Keep the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged. Preserve the camera framing and movement, while adapting the lighting on the person to the target environment.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The character stands, then raises one arm to touch her hair while turning slightly, posing with a hand on her hip.","camera":"Low-angle full-body shot from behind, mostly static with slight reframing as the character turns.","clothing":"Hot pink long-sleeve off-shoulder top, white mini skirt, dark sheer tights, and black lace-up boots.","hair_color":"Bright blonde.","hairstyle":"Blonde hair tied up in a high bun with loose strands at the nape.","identity":"A 3D-rendered female character with a slim build, shown from behind and in profile.","scene":"A futuristic outdoor plaza with a glossy reflective floor, dark domed buildings with glowing teal lights, a tall tower, and a small pink vehicle in the background under a blue sky."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The background was replaced from a street with a large metal container and buildings to the reference's futuristic plaza with reflective floor, dark domed buildings, glowing teal lights, tower, and pink vehicle. The character remains in the same pose sequence and clothing, with lighting now cooler and more reflective, matching the new environment.
arguments.requested_change: Change the scene to the futuristic plaza shown in the reference, keeping the person's identity, hairstyle, hair color, clothing, expression, and action unchanged, preserving camera framing/movement, and adapting the person's lighting to the new environment.
uncertain: Whether the slight change in boot color is an unintended change or a lighting/material adaptation to the new scene.
unexpected_changes: The character's boots appear black in the output rather than the brown/tan color visible in the source.
